correctness.summary: The signed topological-order encoding is well defined for complete multipartite graphs, sink-layer inclusion-exclusion gives the inverse-series identity, and the even/odd algebra reduces the matching-deleted family to perfect-matchings among doubleton parts. Coefficient extraction gives the stated factorial values. A standalone exhaustive verifier checks all 28 parameter pairs with 2<=n<=9.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: The new 2026 acyclic-polynomial source, the complete-multipartite orientation-enumeration literature, the classical acyclic-orientation Gray-code paper, and exact/synonymous searches were checked. No equivalent signature formula for K_n minus a matching or cocktail-party graphs was found. The full current v2 text of arXiv:2609.02249 was not completely inspected and remains the main explicit residual risk.

value.summary: The result gives an exact factorial even/odd imbalance for all cocktail-party graphs and a parity-sensitive near-perfect-matching formula, yielding an infinite dense family of explicit non-Hamiltonian acyclic-orientation graphs and a reusable signed cancellation mechanism.

limitations: The full acyclic polynomial is not determined; only its value at -1 is evaluated.
A zero signature does not imply Hamiltonicity.
The full current v2 text of arXiv:2609.02249 was not completely inspected; its accessible abstract and indexed material were checked.
Older Gray-code, hyperplane-arrangement, or trace-monoid literature using different terminology and very recent parallel work remain residual originality risks.
Finite computation supports but does not replace the proof.
Independent audit has not been performed.
